title: critonia siltepecana
intro: Critonia siltepecana, commonly known as Hierba del Venado, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to help lower blood pressure and improve digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Critonia siltepecana include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
